## User problem

What problem are you trying to solve? Who benefits?

## Proposed behavior

Describe the desired behavior in concrete terms.

## Target milestone

Which roadmap milestone fits best?

- [ ] Milestone 1 — Public-source alpha
- [ ] Milestone 2 — Usable beta
- [ ] Milestone 3 — Distribution readiness
- [ ] Unsure / needs discussion

## Impact assessment

### Protocol

Does this require TS3 protocol changes, new packets, or resolver behavior? Describe.

### Audio

Does this affect capture, playback, codecs, routing, or foreground-service audio types? Describe.

### Security

Could this expose credentials, identities, microphone access, or exported components? Describe.

## Alternatives considered

List other approaches you considered and why this proposal is preferable.

## Additional context

Screenshots, mockups, or links to related issues are welcome. Do not include private server details or credentials.
